description: Search restaurants, cafés and bars recommended by food creators on saved.rsvp. Give words (an area, a dish, a cuisine or kind of place, e.g. "greasy spoon shoreditch", "pie and mash", "dim sum") and/or coordinates to search nearby. Each result says who recommends it, their rank and guide, a quote in their words, and a link.

creator.description: Only this creator (id, handle or name, from list_creators)

query.description: What they want: area, dish, cuisine, kind of place or a venue name

radius_km.description: How far from the point, in km (default 3)

name: search_places
title: Find places food creators recommend
